title: About this gallery
text:
Adding a project

Make a folder under projects/ named after the project, with an index.qmd inside it. Copy the front matter from an existing one.
Fill in title, description, author, date, and categories. Those five fields are what the gallery sorts, searches, and filters on — a project with no categories won’t appear under any topic tag.
Drop a thumbnail.png in the folder (roughly 3:2, 900px wide is plenty) and point image: at it.
Push to main. The site rebuilds itself.

If the project has no home here — it’s a repo, a paper, or an app somewhere else — add an entry to projects/external.yml instead of making a page.
